script.title: FIRST PT VISIT
script.scene_zh: 復健中心 · 預約初診
script.story_hook: A tired dad finally books his first therapy visit.
script.intro_zh: 一位疲憊的爸爸，終於預約了第一次復健。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we book a first physical therapy session. Listen for body and pain words.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們預約第一次復健。留意身體與疼痛的說法。
script.outro: Session booked, socks remembered, back on track!
script.outro_zh: 課程約好了，襪子記住了，背也有救了！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each scheduling phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，我們逐句跟讀預約復健的說法。
script.char_a_description: a tired man in his forties with short sandy hair and light stubble, wearing a gray polo shirt, black athletic pants and worn running shoes, broad shoulders, slightly hunched from pain
script.char_b_description: a woman in her thirties with black hair in a tight high bun, wearing a burgundy polo, navy athletic shorts, white trainers and a wrist stopwatch, tall, upright and confident

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to start physical therapy.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tə stɑɹt ˈfɪzɪkəl ˈθɛɹəpi/
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想開始做復健。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. Do you have a referral form?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt du ju hæv ə ɹɪˈfɜɹəl fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。醫生開的轉診單您帶來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um... a referral? What's that exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ə ɹɪˈfɜɹəl wʌts ðæt ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 呃……轉診單？那到底是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your doctor signs it. We need it first.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈdɑktɚ saɪnz ɪt wi nid ɪt fɜɹst/
dialogue.zh: 就是醫生簽的同意單，我們要先有它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, it's in my truck. On the seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ɪts ɪn maɪ tɹʌk ɑn ðə sit/
dialogue.zh: 那個……它在我貨車座位上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, go grab it. I'll wait right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt ɡoʊ ɡɹæb ɪt aɪl weɪt ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 正好，請去拿，我在這裡等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're so patient. My back hurts just running.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ soʊ ˈpeɪʃənt maɪ bæk hɜɹts dʒʌst ˈɹʌnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 您真有耐心，我光是小跑步就會背痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then walk, don't run. We fix that first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wɔk doʊnt ɹʌn wi fɪks ðæt fɜɹst/
dialogue.zh: 那就用走的，別跑。我們先處理這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. Be right back... okay, got it!
dialogue.phonetic: /dil bi ɹaɪt bæk oʊˈkeɪ ɡɑt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，馬上回來……有了，拿到了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice. Hmm, it says six sessions. That's standard.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs həm ɪt sɛz sɪks ˈsɛʃənz ðæts ˈstændɚd/
dialogue.zh: 好。上面寫六堂課，這是標準安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six? Is that a lot, honestly?
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ɪz ðæt ə lɑt ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 六堂？說實話，算多嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's a start. Doctors decide that, not me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ə stɑɹt ˈdɑktɚz dɪˈsaɪd ðæt nɑt mi/
dialogue.zh: 先從基本量開始。次數是醫生定的，我說了不算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it hurt? The therapy, I mean.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ɪt hɜɹt ði ˈθɛɹəpi aɪ min/
dialogue.zh: 復健會不會痛？我是說治療本身。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sore muscles after, a little. Worth it.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔɹ ˈmʌsəlz ˈæftɚ ə ˈlɪtəl wɜɹð ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 事後肌肉會痠一點，但很值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes... that's a whole other story.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæts ə hoʊl ˈʌðɚ ˈstɔɹi/
dialogue.zh: 對喔……那就話長了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You moved boxes last weekend, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju mud bɑksəz læst ˈwikˌɛnd ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 上週末您搬了一堆紙箱，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did you guess my wife's exact words?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dɪd ju ɡɛs maɪ waɪfs ɪɡˈzækt wɜɹdz/
dialogue.zh: 您怎麼猜到的？我太太的原話就是這句。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every May, it's boxes or golf swings.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvɹi meɪ ɪts bɑksəz ɔɹ ɡɑlf swɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 每年五月，不是搬箱子就是揮高爾夫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guilty. So, where exactly does it hurt?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɪlti soʊ wɛɹ ɪɡˈzæktli dʌz ɪt hɜɹt/
dialogue.zh: 您猜中了吧。所以，到底哪裡痛？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Point with one finger. Not a hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔɪnt wɪð wʌn ˈfɪŋɡɚ nɑt ə hænd/
dialogue.zh: 請伸一根手指指位置，不要整隻手比。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right here... low, on the left side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt hɪɹ loʊ ɑn ðə lɛft saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡……後腰左下一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Classic. Does it ever go down your leg?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklæsɪk dʌz ɪt ˈɛvɚ ɡoʊ daʊn jʊɹ lɛɡ/
dialogue.zh: 很典型。會一路延伸到腿上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only when I sneeze. Then, wow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wɛn aɪ sniz ðɛn waʊ/
dialogue.zh: 打噴嚏的時候會，那個威力啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll watch that. No heavy bending yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl wɑtʃ ðæt noʊ ˈhɛvɪ ˈbɛndɪŋ jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 我們會留意這個，暫時別彎腰提重物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So my wife carries the boxes now?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ maɪ waɪf ˈkæɹiz ðə bɑksəz naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那搬箱子就換我太太了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart man. Now, your schedule. Evenings?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt mæn naʊ jʊɹ ˈskɛdʒuəl ˈivnɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。來說說您的時段，晚上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twice a week. Evenings are tough, kids.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ə wik ˈivnɪŋz ɑɹ tʌf kɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 一週兩次，晚上不行，要顧小孩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuesdays and Thursdays, at noon?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzˌdeɪz ænd ˈθɜɹzˌdeɪz æt nun/
dialogue.zh: 那週二、週四的中午如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noon is tight. Could we do nine-thirty?
dialogue.phonetic: /nun ɪz taɪt kʊd wi du naɪn ˈθɜɹti/
dialogue.zh: 中午太趕，九點半可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check... nine is open, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk naɪn ɪz ˈoʊpən ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 我看看……九點有空的，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine? Ouch. That's my second alarm.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn aʊtʃ ðæts maɪ ˈsɛkənd əˈlɑɹm/
dialogue.zh: 九點？那是我第二個鬧鐘的時間耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's the early bird slot, take it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ði ˈɜɹli bɜɹd slɑt teɪk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這是早鳥時段，搶著用喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, fine. I'll be the one yawning.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn faɪn aɪl bi ðə wʌn ˈjɔnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好啦好啦，屆時打哈欠的一定是我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Tuesday it is. Wear comfy clothes.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈtuzˌdeɪ ɪt ɪz wɛɹ ˈkʌmfi kloʊz/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！就週二。記得穿舒適的衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Comfy. Got it. Anything else to bring?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌmfi ɡɑt ɪt ˈɛnɪθɪŋ ɛls tə brɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 舒適的衣服，記下了。還要帶什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The form, shoes, and a water bottle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɔɹm ʃuz ænd ə ˈwɔtɚ ˈbɑtəl/
dialogue.zh: 轉診單、運動鞋，還有水壺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a towel? People ask.
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ə ˈtaʊəl ˈpipəl æsk/
dialogue.zh: 要帶毛巾嗎？總有人問這題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We wash ours daily. Bring a smile only.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɑʃ ˈaʊɚz ˈdeɪli brɪŋ ə smaɪl ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 我們的天天洗，您帶笑容來就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That smile costs extra, but okay.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt smaɪl kɔsts ˈɛkstɹə bʌt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這個笑容要加錢喔，好吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll bill your insurance. What's the name?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl bɪl jʊɹ ɪnˈʃʊɚəns wʌts ðə neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 費用會請保險公司付，保險公司叫什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blue Shield. The card's in the folder.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu ʃild ðə kɑɹdz ɪn ðə ˈfoʊldɚ/
dialogue.zh: 藍盾。卡就夾在那個資料夾裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. One small rule for session one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt wʌn smɔl ɹul fɚ ˈsɛʃən wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 好。第一堂課有一個小規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No golf talk? Deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɡɑlf tɔk dil/
dialogue.zh: 不能聊高爾夫？成交。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, no. Clean gym socks. We walk barefoot.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ noʊ klin dʒɪm sɑks wi wɔk ˈbɛɹˌfʊt/
dialogue.zh: 不，是要乾淨的運動襪，我們要赤腳走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Barefoot? My feet have opinions.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛɹˌfʊt maɪ fit hæv əˈpɪnjənz/
dialogue.zh: 赤腳？我的腳可是有意見的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They'll thank you. Grip work helps backs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪl θæŋk ju ɡɹɪp wɜɹk hɛlpz bæks/
dialogue.zh: 它們會感謝您的，抓地練習對背有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who knew feet had a desk job?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu nun fit hæd ə dɛsk dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 誰知道腳也有辦公室工作啊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly my philosophy. Tuesday, nine sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli maɪ fəˈlɑsəfi ˈtuzˌdeɪ naɪn ʃɑɹp/
dialogue.zh: 正是我的哲學。週二九點整。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sharp. Should I come early first time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɑɹp ʃʊd aɪ kʌm ˈɜɹli fɜɹst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 準時。第一次要早點到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes, to park and fill one page.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnəts tə pɑɹk ænd fɪl wʌn peɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 早十分鐘，好停車再填一頁資料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine minus ten, my alarm hates me.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈmɪnəs tɛn maɪ əˈlɑɹm heɪts mi/
dialogue.zh: 九點減十分，我的鬧鐘會恨我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set two alarms, that's the trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt tu əˈlɑɹmz ðæts ðə tɹɪk/
dialogue.zh: 設兩個鬧鐘，這是祕訣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Um, can I cancel if it rains?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ʌm kæn aɪ ˈkænsl ɪf ɪt reɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 對了，下雨可以取消嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain is fine. Fever, then call us.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪn ɪz faɪn ˈfivɚ ðɛn kɔl ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 下雨沒關係，發燒才要打電話來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted. That felt longer than a booking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪd ðæt fɛlt ˈlɔŋɚ ðæn ə ˈbʊkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。這比單純掛號久多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the plan. Tuesdays and Thursdays, nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə plæn ˈtuzˌdeɪz ænd ˈθɜɹzˌdeɪz naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 這就是計畫。週二、週四，九點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife won't believe I did this.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ waɪf woʊnt bɪˈliv aɪ dɪd ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我太太一定不敢相信我辦到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell her the back starts Tuesday. Bye!
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɜɹ ðə bæk stɑɹts ˈtuzˌdeɪ baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 就跟她說，背從週二開始救。再見！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you Tuesday. Bring on the socks.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ˈtuzˌdeɪ brɪŋ ɑn ðə sɑks/
dialogue.zh: 週二見，來吧，襪子！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean socks, early bird. See you!
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ klin sɑks ˈɜɹli bɜɹd si ju/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！乾淨襪子加早鳥，再見！

script.youtube_description:
60句復健預約聽力練習：第一次約物理治療，轉診單是什麼？到底會不會痛？

這一集跟著一位搬箱子閃到腰的爸爸，從確認轉診單、指出疼痛位置、談幾次療程，到敲時間、問要帶什麼、聽赤腳練習的規定，把復健初診的每一步聽懂。

你會聽到：
- 預約開頭：「Hi, I'd like to start physical therapy.」
- 描述疼痛：「Low, on the left side.」
- 敲時間：「Noon is tight. Could we do nine-thirty?」
- 問該帶什麼：「Anything else to bring?」

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，把這些句子聽熟、說順。

60 lines of physical therapy listening practice: a dad who threw his back out moving boxes walks in to book his very first session. What is a referral form? Will therapy hurt? Can he really arrive at 9 a.m.?

You will hear how to book a first PT visit, describe exactly where it hurts, talk about sessions and insurance, agree on a time, and learn what to bring. The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.
